name: monday.com
shortInfo: The monday.com is a cloud-based platform that allows users to create their own applications and project management software.
brief: The monday.com platform is a customizable workOS that empowers teams to build processes, create projects, and complete day-to-day work according to their needs.
about:
The monday.com Connector enables streaming relevant monday.com data into a user determined data warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.

Check more about monday.com api documentation [here](https://dataapi.upscripthealth.org/docs).
